name: Defending Your Family
overview: Scripture acknowledges the responsibility and right to defend one’s family and home, as seen when God permits taking decisive action against a thief breaking in (Exodus 22:2). Nehemiah demonstrates the practical preparation and arming of families to protect their community (Nehemiah 4:13), while David praises the Lord as the source of strength and skill for battle (Psalms 144:1). Even Jesus instructs His disciples to be prepared by arming themselves appropriately (Luke 22:36), underscoring the biblical principle that safeguarding loved ones is both wise and necessary under God’s guidance.
